data.body: **[P1] Keep permanent path failures out of invocation retry.** This catches every read-side `IOException`—including `NOFOLLOW` rejecting a symlink or a configured path that is not a directory—and labels it `RetryablePayloadOffloadException`. `DurableExecutor` then rethrows it for backend retry, so these non-healing configurations can loop indefinitely instead of failing the execution. Convert path-validation, symlink, and not-directory failures to `PayloadOffloadException`, reserve the retryable subtype for genuinely transient I/O, and apply the same classification to the store catch.
